text: The Founding Festival. Banners on every tower, fire-pits in every yard — for one week, nobody at Vael is a house or a rank.

speaker: Kael
text: They light the pits in the founders' pattern. Four fires. One for each line that swore.

speaker: Liora
text: LESS brooding, MORE festival! Kai — fire-pits. Cooking. You and me, right now. It's tradition and I don't make the rules.
Liora taught you the fire-pit tradition! You can now COOK with housemates in the Common Hall.
